automation.title: Automation
automation.desc: Create scheduled tasks and let AI run them on a schedule.

standup.name: Standup Digest
standup.desc: Summarize the commits, module changes, and follow-up items since the last business day.
standup.prompt: Summarize the commits, module changes, CI status, and follow-up items since the last business day, and produce a spoken standup summary of no more than 5 bullet points. Read-only analysis; do not modify code or external state. When the evidence is insufficient, state it explicitly and do not speculate.

risk.name: Risk Scan
risk.desc: Review the code changes from the last 24 hours and report high-confidence risks backed by direct evidence.
risk.prompt: Review the code changes from the last 24 hours and identify high-confidence risks such as runtime errors, data loss, permission bypass, resource leaks, and cross-platform compatibility issues, attaching code and commit/diff evidence. Read-only analysis, using only verifiable repository facts. When the evidence is insufficient, state it explicitly; do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.

release.name: Release Brief
release.desc: Compile this week's merged changes into a team-facing and a user-facing release summary.
release.prompt: Compile the changes merged this week, categorize them into new features, fixes, refactors, and breaking changes, and produce a technical summary for the team and release notes for users. Read-only analysis, with a commit or PR reference for every item; do not modify code or external state.

docsync.name: Doc Sync Check
docsync.desc: Compare recent implementation changes against the docs to find updates that may have been missed.
docsync.prompt: Compare recent implementation changes against the README, docs, configuration references, and usage examples to check whether they match the current code, then list the documentation locations that need to be added or corrected and explain why. Read-only analysis; do not edit the docs directly, and mark anything that cannot be confirmed as pending human review.
